geometry.boundary: Original pose only. Approximate seat/ground markers are source observations, not hidden-bone measurements. No endpoint travel, different furniture or motion is claimed.
geometry.supportObservation: Pelvis sits on the right bench front; one palm presses the cushion beside the hip and the other rests on her own thigh. Two separate lower-leg/ankle-strap-shoe chains and short-heel contacts remain at the original positions.

compositing.transform: identity; every layer retains the full 1536x1024 source canvas
compositing.shadowRole: Existing separate, edge-limited contact residual; not multiply and not a carried floor patch.
compositing.caveat: The contact residual production record solved against calibrated background v4, while the existing scene chose complete candidate v1. This exact combined candidate is exposed in the page for contact/edge review; matching RGB hashes alone do not prove the composite equals the mother.
compositing.boundary: This is a static original-pose candidate, not a new free-moving shadow system. The receiver contains floor RGB and must remain world-locked with travel zero.
